probe_source:
# frozen_string_literal: true
require 'json'
require 'gritz/native'
require_relative '../spec/fixtures/hello/hello_services_pb'
if ENV['PROBE_BASELINE'] == '1'
  Gritz::Transport::Native::Cancellation.send(:remove_const, :Descriptor)
  Gritz::Transport::Native::Cancellation.const_set(:Descriptor, GRPC::RpcDesc)
end
controller = Class.new(Gritz::Controller) do
  bind Helloworld::Greeter::Service
  def say_hello = Helloworld::HelloReply.new(message: 'ok')
end
config = Gritz::Configuration.new
config.bind = '127.0.0.1:0'
config.threads = 8
samples = []
Gritz::Testing::Server.start(config, controllers: [controller]) do |server|
  stub = Helloworld::Greeter::Stub.new(server.address, :this_channel_is_insecure)
  request = Helloworld::HelloRequest.new
  200.times { stub.say_hello(request) }
  3.times do
    GC.start
    allocations = GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects)
    latencies = Array.new(2000) do
      started = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC, :nanosecond)
      raise 'unexpected response' unless stub.say_hello(request).message == 'ok'
      Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC, :nanosecond) - started
    end
    samples << { p50_ns: latencies.sort[1000], allocations_per_rpc: (GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects) - allocations) / 2000.0 }
  end
end
report = { platform: RUBY_PLATFORM, ruby: RUBY_VERSION, grpc: Gem.loaded_specs.fetch('grpc').version.to_s, baseline: ENV['PROBE_BASELINE'] == '1', samples: samples, fixed_runner: false, note: 'Sequential short probe on shared VM; not a fixed-runner performance target verification.' }
File.write(ARGV.fetch(0), JSON.pretty_generate(report) + "\n")
puts JSON.generate(report)
